title: Demotion of canonical/non-canonical inflammasome and pyroptosis alleviates ischemia/reperfusion-induced acute kidney injury: Novel role of the D2/D3 receptor agonist ropinirole.
authors: Henedak, Nada T; El-Abhar, Hanan S; Abdallah, Dalaal M; Ahmed, Kawkab A; Soubh, Ayman A
one_liner_zh: 该文研究多巴胺受体激动剂ropinirole对肾缺血再灌注损伤的抗炎抗焦亡作用，仅涉及小分子-受体对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Ropinirole used to treat Parkinson's disease highly targets the dopaminergic receptor D3 over the D2 receptor but although both are expressed in the kidneys the ropinirole potential to treat kidney injury provoked by ischemia/reperfusion (I/R) is undraped. We investigated whether ropinirole can alleviate renal I/R by studying its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-pyroptotic effects targeting its aptitude to inhibit the High-mobility group box 1/Toll-like receptor 4/Nuclear factor-kappa B (HMGB1/TLR4/NF-kappaB) cue and the canonical/non-canonical NOD-like receptor family pyrin domain containing 3 (NLRP3) inflammasome trajectories. Herein, bilateral I/R surgery was induced in animals to be either untreated or treated with ropinirole for three days after the insult. Ropinirole successfully improved the histopathological picture and renal function which was confirmed by reducing cystatin C and the standard parameters creatinine and blood urea nitrogen (BUN). Ropinirole achieved this through its anti-inflammatory capacity mediated by reducing the HMGB1/TLR4 axis and inactivating NF-kappaB, which are upstream regulators of the NLRP3 pathway. As a result, the injurious inflammasome markers (NLRP3, apoptosis-associated speck-like protein (ASC), active caspase-1) and their target cytokines interleukin-1 beta (IL-1beta) and IL-18 were decreased. Ropinirole also reduced the pyroptotic cell death markers caspase-11 and gasdermin-D. Furthermore, ropinirole by replenishing antioxidants and decreasing malondialdehyde helped to reduce oxidative stress in the kidneys. The docking findings confirmed that ropinirole highly binds to the dopaminergic D3 receptor more than to the D2 receptor. In conclusion, ropinirole has the potential to be a reno-therapeutic treatment against I/R insult by abating the inflammatory NLRP3 inflammasome signal, pyroptosis, and oxidative stress.
abstract_zh: 用于治疗帕金森病的罗匹尼罗高度靶向多巴胺能D3受体而非D2受体，但尽管这两种受体在肾脏中均有表达，罗匹尼罗治疗缺血/再灌注（I/R）所致肾损伤的潜力尚未被揭示。我们通过研究罗匹尼罗的抗炎、抗氧化和抗焦亡作用，探讨其是否能缓解肾脏I/R，重点关注其抑制高迁移率族蛋白B1/Toll样受体4/核因子-κB（HMGB1/TLR4/NF-kappaB）信号通路及经典/非经典NOD样受体家族含pyrin结构域蛋白3（NLRP3）炎症小体途径的能力。在此，对动物实施双侧I/R手术，术后分别不治疗或给予罗匹尼罗治疗三天。罗匹尼罗成功改善了组织病理学图像和肾功能，这通过降低胱抑素C及标准参数肌酐和血尿素氮（BUN）得到证实。罗匹尼罗通过其抗炎能力实现这一效果，具体机制为减少HMGB1/TLR4轴并失活NF-kappaB，这些是NLRP3通路的上游调控因子。因此，有害的炎症小体标志物（NLRP3、凋亡相关斑点样蛋白（ASC）、活性caspase-1）及其靶细胞因子白细胞介素-1β（IL-1beta）和IL-18均减少。罗匹尼罗还降低了焦亡细胞死亡标志物caspase-11和gasdermin-D。此外，罗匹尼罗通过补充抗氧化剂和减少丙二醛，有助于减轻肾脏中的氧化应激。分子对接结果证实，罗匹尼罗与多巴胺能D3受体的结合亲和力高于D2受体。总之，罗匹尼罗通过抑制炎症性NLRP3炎症小体信号、焦亡和氧化应激，具有作为针对I/R损伤的肾脏治疗药物的潜力。
